purpose: Independent-dataset replication of whether session adaptation improves the relevance/diversity trade-off; no guarantee of a positive result
dataset: Retailrocket official Kaggle archive, local data/retailrocket/manifest.json contains SHA256 hashes
task_change: Next-view recommendation rather than supplied search-candidate reranking; absolute metrics are not interchangeable with Diginetica
session: visitorid and UTC date, new episode after >1200000ms inactivity; target views must have a strictly earlier observed event
request_time: Most recent strictly earlier event timestamp; use only the observed prefix and the last 20 minutes at that point
sampling: Seeded whole eligible episodes, up to 6000/1500/10000 train/validation/confirmation; train/validation seed4285, fresh confirmation seed20261031; no target-dependent test eligibility
candidate_retrieval: Top 200 archive-popular items in the latest observed item's archive-known category, or top 200 globally when category is unknown; never inject the held-out target
metadata: Last item-property snapshot strictly before archive cutoff; property/value tokens excluding availability; categories as of the same cutoff; future snapshots excluded
seed_sensitivity_design: Primary seed uses the original sampled training episodes; the other two use whole-training-episode bootstrap samples with replacement, keeping fixed hyperparameters. No best confirmation seed is selected.

model_hyperparameters.features: Same 22-feature schema, zero price when unavailable; latest-item properties substitute for absent search tokens

policy_selection: Primary seed 4285: maximize validation property-token ILD with <=1% relative loss in both conditional NDCG and Recall; all policies and model hashes frozen before confirmation
metrics: unconditional next-view Hit@10 counting retrieval misses as zero
uncertainty: 1000 paired visitor-cluster bootstrap draws; paired static-versus-adaptive differences; seed sensitivity reported without choosing the best confirmation seed
interpretation: Independent method-transfer test with changed task and representation. Does not establish causal shopper benefit, semantic diversity, or an exact reproduction of subscription-only music-paper results.
correction: Retailrocket raw category 0 is valid. Encode every known category as raw+1 and reserve 0 exclusively for missing metadata.
previous_version: config/submission_replication_protocol.json; results/submission/replication retains the initial diagnostic run
confirmation_reservation: Exclude every visitor present in the initial independent confirmation metadata, then sample up to 10000 whole eligible episodes with seed 20261031, before fitting/scoring corrected models.
